$comment: Temporary buffs fixture (#200). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It declares one buff of each kind and each duration scope, every stacking mode, both targets, every expiry, and a tradeoff (a boon granted beside the burden that pays for it) - granted by a completion rule and by edge effects. buffs.test.ts holds it to the parser, the runtime and the lint, packages/server/src/handlers/buffs.test.ts plays it through the server, and tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs holds it to the schema; docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md (Temporary buffs) walks through it.
title: The Humming Spring
blurb: A spring that hums with rift energy, a den with something in it, and a dawn beyond.

rift-shield.$comment: Guard for the next two fights, gone the moment a fight is lost. Granted again, it starts its two fights over.
rift-shield.label: Rift Shield

rift-surge.$comment: Harder hits for one hero's first two turns of the next fight. Drinking again stacks it, to +2 at most.
rift-surge.label: Rift Surge

rift-fury.$comment: The rift's price, part one: a sharp eye for the next fight...
rift-fury.label: Rift Fury

rift-fray.$comment: ...part two: and frayed nerves for the same fight. Granted together, on the same edge.
rift-fray.label: Frayed Nerves

fleet-step.$comment: Lighter feet for one fight, until the party next rests.
fleet-step.label: Fleet Step

camp-to-den.label: The long way to the den
